entries.1b7ea9302e6a9c90: This covers the condominium management services performed by Sumitomo Fudosan Tatemono Service Co., Ltd. and the interior sales performed by Sumitomo Fudosan Cyscon Co., Ltd. Both have been classified under the Real Estate Sales Business from the fiscal year ended March 2026 (until the previous year, condominium management was under the Real Estate Leasing Business and interior sales under the Construction Business).
entries.1fc9198e8a61db15: Condominium series 'City Tower' and 'City Terrace' (City Tower Toranomon, City Terrace Tamagawa, City Towers Itabashi Oyama, etc.)
entries.435f6d36caace7d2: Homeowners looking to rebuild or renovate their homes
entries.56ea11f9e907b39f: Sales agency for housing and other properties, leasing brokerage
entries.5a77cfa49a8b5e86: This is a large-scale renovation business that regenerates housing by making use of the existing building's foundations, columns, beams and other structure. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥103,201 million, and orders received totaled 6,559 buildings. The company explains that the product grew out of the idea, prompted by the Great Hanshin-Awaji Earthquake of 1995, of whether housing could be regenerated at a lower cost than rebuilding and with greater earthquake resistance. It describes the product as featuring reliable seismic reinforcement and a fixed-price system.
entries.7c2086c8100cb2d9: Individuals and corporations buying and selling real estate
entries.95318aa08fc0563b: A real estate company that develops and leases office buildings mainly in central Tokyo, and also handles condominium sales, renovation and contract construction of detached houses, and real estate brokerage.
entries.9e51aed9e2109520: This is leasing centered on office buildings. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, external customer revenue was ¥404,878 million, accounting for the majority of real estate leasing revenue. The company states that 95% of its leased office buildings are located in Tokyo's 23 wards, 84% are located in central Tokyo (the central seven wards), and its total owned floor area exceeds 1.5 million tsubo. In the current period, improved occupancy at existing buildings, the spread of rent increases, and full-year operation of Sumitomo Fudosan Nakano Ekimae Building and Sumitomo Fudosan Shinjuku Minamiguchi Building contributed.
entries.aa037bb7900e2821: Leasing and operation of commercial facilities
entries.b35b9946fb1e42ab: This covers construction contracting for new detached houses and other new housing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥85,471 million, and orders received totaled 1,786 buildings. Orders received totaled ¥83,187 million, up ¥1,864 million from the previous year.
entries.bce274a764d19d26: This covers the sale of condominiums and detached houses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥252,055 million. The company explains that, because supply was limited while demand remained firm and selling prices rose further, revenue and profit increased even though the number of units booked fell by 158 from the previous year.
entries.c9bc6e4ec268e202: Custom-built homes (construction contracting for new detached houses and other new housing)
entries.d29cdeca09abdf89: This segment consists of the fitness club business, the food and beverage business and others. Sumitomo Fudosan Esuforuta Co., Ltd. operates fitness clubs, Izumi Restaurant Co., Ltd. runs the food and beverage business, Izumi Insurance Service Co., Ltd. runs the insurance agency business, and Izumi Country Club Co., Ltd. operates a golf course. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥13,205 million.
entries.d4c259f5e1586c48: This segment undertakes construction and renovation work for detached houses. Sumitomo Fudosan Housing Co., Ltd., which took over the construction business of Sumitomo Realty & Development Co., Ltd. through an absorption-type company split on April 1, 2025, is in charge and carries out the 'Shinchiku Sokkurisan' rebuilding business and the construction contracting business for new detached houses and other new housing. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥188,702 million, and segment profit was ¥13,420 million. Orders received in the same period totaled 8,345 buildings (6,559 for Shinchiku Sokkurisan and 1,786 for custom-built homes). The company cites as reasons for the sharp decline in profit the substantial fall in orders, mainly in the first half, due to the impact of the revision of the Building Standards Act, and the costs incurred with the company split.

entries.e905e2dff139f616: Sales of detached houses and residential lots
entries.ecdc841d94ad1b70: This business is operated by subsidiaries that lease buildings owned by Sumitomo Realty & Development Co., Ltd. Sumitomo Fudosan Villa Fontaine Co., Ltd. operates hotels, Sumitomo Fudosan Bellesalle Co., Ltd. operates event halls and meeting rooms, and Sumitomo Fudosan Commercial Management Co., Ltd. operates commercial facilities. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, together with the luxury rental apartments “La Tour”, higher unit prices and improved occupancy contributed to the increase in profit of the real estate leasing business.
